## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 345 captures during October 2018. Capture activity is reported for the month as a whole. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 345 captures, 18 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.2 per cent. The ungradable images are identified separately from the images available for grading. The reported rate is based on the total capture activity at West Gate Eye Clinic during October 2018.

## Grading

There were 45 referable results. The median grading lag was 2. This provides the reported measure of the interval associated with grading activity during the month. Together, the capture, image quality and grading figures summarise site operations at West Gate Eye Clinic for October 2018.
